description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: He is a great software developer.
family.exampleCn: 他是一位优秀的软件开发者。

family.example: The development of hybrid rice helped many people.
family.exampleCn: 杂交水稻的发展帮助了许多人。
中国是一个发展中国家。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: 动词develop加-ment变成名词development，加-er变成人developer。过去分词developed也可以作形容词表「发达的」。

family.example: Yuan Longping was a great scientist.
family.exampleCn: 袁隆平是一位伟大的科学家。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: science是「科学」，加-ist变成做科学的人scientist（科学家），加-ific变成形容词scientific（科学的）。

family.exampleCn: 爱迪生是一位伟大的发明家。

family.example: The phone is a great invention.
family.exampleCn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: invent加-or变成人inventor（发明家），加-ion变成名词invention（发明物）。

family.example: My grandpa has a big farm.
He liked farming at an early age.
family.exampleCn: 他很小的时候就喜欢农业。

family.example: There is a lot of farmland here.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: farm是农场，加-er变成在农场工作的人farmer（农民），加-ing变成farming（农业/耕作这个行业）。
hard既可以作形容词（困难的）也可以作副词（努力地）。hardly意思完全不同，是「几乎不」。hard+working = hardworking（勤奋的）。

family.exampleCn: 他是一位伟大的科学家。

family.example: His greatness is in helping others.
family.exampleCn: 他的伟大在于帮助他人。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: great加-ly变成副词greatly（非常），加-ness变成名词greatness（伟大）。-ness是常见的名词后缀。

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were born in + 时间/地点
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: He was born in 1930 in Beijing.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: be born 表示「出生」，因为人是被生下来的，所以用被动语态。常用过去时 was/were born。注意：表示出生年份和城市都用介词in。

transferExamples.english: I was born in 2014 in Nanjing.
She was born in Shanghai.
They were born in the same year.
My dad was born in a small town.
transferExamples.chinese: 我爸爸出生在一个小镇上。

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + never + 动词过去式 + ...
sentencePatterns.patternCn: 某人从不……（过去从不做某事）
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: It was very difficult, but he never gave up.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 这非常困难，但他从不放弃。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: never + 动词过去式 表示「过去从不做某事」，比一般否定句语气更强，强调「从来没有」。never放在行为动词之前，be动词之后。

transferExamples.english: He never told a lie.
She never ate junk food.
They never gave up their dream.
I never forgot his words.

sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 谢谢你昨天带我宝宝去公园。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: Thanks for doing sth. 表示「为做了某事而感谢」。for是介词，后面要跟动名词（动词-ing形式）。

transferExamples.english: Thanks for helping me.
Thanks for coming to my party.
transferExamples.chinese: 谢谢你来参加我的派对。

transferExamples.english: Thanks for telling me the news.
transferExamples.chinese: 谢谢你告诉我这个消息。

transferExamples.english: Thanks for lending me your book.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + be ready to + 动词原形
sentencePatterns.patternCn: 某人准备好/乐意做某事
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: You're always ready to help others.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: be ready to do sth. 有两个意思：一是「准备好做某事」，二是「乐意做某事」。本单元中表示「乐意」的意思。

transferExamples.english: I'm ready to start.
She is always ready to help.
They are ready to try again.
He is ready to face the challenge.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + don't/doesn't have to + 动词原形
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Great people don't have to be famous.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: don't have to do sth. 表示「不必做某事」，和 needn't 意思相近。注意这里的to后面跟动词原形。

transferExamples.english: You don't have to go now.
She doesn't have to finish it today.
We don't have to be perfect.
He doesn't have to come early.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：Yuan Longping was a great ______. (science)
growthExercises.explanation: 这里需要一个表示「人」的名词，scientist是科学家的意思。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：He ______ hybrid rice in 1973. (develop)
growthExercises.explanation: 这里需要一个动词作谓语，in 1973是过去时间，所以用过去式developed。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：I / be born / 2014 / Wuhan
growthExercises.answer: I was born in 2014 in Wuhan.
growthExercises.explanation: be born in + 年份/地点，表示出生于某年某地。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：谢谢你告诉我这个故事。
growthExercises.answer: Thanks for telling me this story.
growthExercises.explanation: Thanks for doing sth. 感谢做某事，for后跟动名词。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：你不必每天都来。
growthExercises.answer: You don't have to come every day.
growthExercises.explanation: don't have to do sth. 不必做某事。
